title: 第15章 有如神助绝世剑法小成第16章 下山
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
张宿进入到了修炼室。
他并不知道在长老眼中，对他的评价又低了不少。
不过，就算知道，他也不会在意。
他有自己的修炼计划，何须在意他人看法？
张宿仔细翻看完光影杀剑。
这门剑法，最重要的其实还不是快，而是观察。
需要时刻观察四周的环境。
利用四周的环境，让剑法威能更强。
比如，在黑夜，他就能利用夜色掩护光影杀剑，令人防不胜防。
如果是在白天，阳光明媚，那施展光影杀剑，甚至还会让人觉得晃眼。
如果真的因为晃眼而闭上眼睛，后果不堪设想。
那光影杀剑就会瞬间刺出，一击必杀！
还有诸如下雨、树林等等。
各种环境都可以“掩护”或者“增强”光影杀剑。
这就是光影杀剑的可怕之处。
但同时，这难度也太高了。
一个人，要精通各种环境对光影杀剑的掩护或者增强，太难了。
而且，只有35%契合度，张宿也练不成。
不过，张宿还剩下八点契合值。
这个时候就派上用场了。

下一刻，张宿集中注意力，将七点契合值加在了光影杀剑上。
顿时，光影杀剑的契合度暴涨。
“光影杀剑：契合度100%（未入门）”
光影杀剑的契合度直接达到了100%，虽然还没有入门，可张宿脑海中回忆着光影杀剑的内容时，却隐隐有种极其强烈的熟悉感。
张宿几乎下意识握住了冷霜剑的剑柄。
“铿”。
冷霜剑出鞘。
没有漫天的剑影。
甚至连光芒都没有。
隐约只感觉到微风拂面。
然后，冷霜剑瞬间就斩在了修炼室内的一张桌子上。
“嗤”。
冷霜剑很锋利。
剑锋一斩，顷刻间便斩落了桌子的一角。
张宿瞳孔猛地一缩。
content_en:
Zhang Su entered the practice room.
He didn't know that in the eyes of the elders, his evaluation was much lower.
However, even if he knew, he wouldn't care.
He has his own cultivation plan, why should he care about other people's opinions?
Zhang Su carefully read through the Light and Shadow Killing Sword.
In fact, the most important thing about this swordsmanship is not speed, but observation.
You need to always observe your surroundings.
Use the surrounding environment to make your swordsmanship more powerful.
For example, in the dark night, he can use the night to cover up the light and shadow to kill the sword, making it difficult to guard against.
If it was during the day and the sun was shining brightly, using the Light and Shadow Killing Sword would even make people feel dazzled.
If you really close your eyes because of glare, the consequences will be disastrous.
The light and shadow killing sword will stab out instantly, killing with one strike!
There are also things like rain, woods, etc.
Various environments can "cover" or "enhance" the light and shadow sword.
This is the terrifying thing about the light and shadow killing sword.
But at the same time, this is too difficult.
It is too difficult for a person to be proficient in protecting or enhancing the light and shadow killing sword in various environments.
Moreover, with only a 35% fit, Zhang Su couldn't practice it.
However, Zhang Su still has eight points of compatibility left.
This is where it comes in handy.
The next moment, Zhang Su concentrated his attention and added seven points of compatibility value to the light and shadow killing sword.
Suddenly, the compatibility between the light and shadow killing swords skyrocketed.
"Light and Shadow Killing Sword: 100% compatibility (not yet started)"
The compatibility of the Light and Shadow Killing Sword directly reached 100%. Although he had not started yet, when Zhang Su recalled the contents of the Light and Shadow Killing Sword in his mind, he felt a very strong sense of familiarity.
Zhang Su almost subconsciously held the hilt of the cold frost sword.
"Keng".
The frost sword was unsheathed.
There are no shadows of swords filling the sky.
Not even light.
I could only vaguely feel the breeze blowing on my face.
Then, the cold frost sword struck a table in the training room in an instant.
"laugh".
The frost sword is very sharp.
With one slash of the sword, a corner of the table fell off in an instant.
Zhang Su's pupils shrank suddenly.
